pu3_assessment.selected_option: D. Maintain Two Scores (Statistical Anomaly Score & Operational State-Transition Score)
pu3_assessment.scientific_validity: Pump PU3 is OFF continuously during normal baseline training (variance mu_sq ~ 2.9e-8). When PU3 turns ON in test set, dividing by near-zero variance yields normalized residual Z ~ 4.87e11. This is a mathematically valid state-transition signal, not corrupted data.
pu3_assessment.dashboard_recommendation: The raw statistical score should be preserved for mathematical integrity, while the production dashboard displays a Log-Scaled or Variance-Floored score to prevent single-sensor operational switches from eclipsing localized hydraulic anomalies.

severity_assessment.numerical_limitation: Current formula scales quadratically with peak score, causing extreme single-sensor residual spikes (~10^11) to produce severity scores of ~10^19-10^20, dominating the ranking.
severity_assessment.proposed_dashboard_formula: Severity_Log = log10(1 + Mean_Score) * sqrt(Duration_Hours) * (1 + log10(1 + Peak_Score / tau))

required_fixes.problem: Timestamp parsing in BATADALDatasetLoader uses default pd.to_datetime without format='%d/%m/%y %H' or dayfirst=True, causing non-monotonic date ordering when day <= 12.
required_fixes.proposed_fix: Update line 85 to pd.to_datetime(df[self.timestamp_col], dayfirst=True, format='%d/%m/%y %H', errors='coerce')
required_fixes.expected_impact: Ensures all future automated inference pipelines parse timestamps monotonically without requiring wrapper scripts.
